open_points.subject: advance_run guarded edges from flow inputs
open_points.text: an edge is disabled only once its source node concluded succeeded and its guard port's value differs from the guard value; an edge whose source has not concluded is neither enabled nor disabled, so a port with such an edge can still receive a value
open_points.other_text: flow inputs delivered along every edge from them — a flow input or flow output endpoint is the node whose node_id is the empty string (A05 rule 2), never the flow_id —
open_points.question: Must edges from flow inputs be delivered immediately, or remain neither enabled nor disabled because their empty-string source endpoint never concludes? One passage must change or explicitly define a flow input endpoint as already concluded succeeded.
